## AI-assisted development
- Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code among them) with MCP servers and custom skills.
- Writes own agent skills to automate routine work.
- Automated product health checks: scheduled Claude Code runs read retention, revenue, crashes and ratings via MCP from internal analytics and post a daily report with period-over-period trend to the team messenger. Saved reporting time and reduced team tension.
- Pushed the team to agent-assisted development; gave in-studio talks for non-technical colleagues.

## Impact at Voodoo (Archery Clash!)
- +5pp D1 retention on low-end Android device tiers (T4-T5) via adaptive quality settings.
- ~+10% D1-D7 playtime with no revenue drop (ad grace time A/B test).
- +5pp store conversion, statistically significant (listing experiment).
- +30% revenue in T3 countries (-50% prices).
